The '''''Firefox''''' was a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to defend the ''[[Sealion]]'', a prototype of the [[Missile Boat]] that was sent to the [[XQ4 Platform]] [[Enin'sd]] by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|Cruiser]] ''[[Link]]''. When the first Strike cruiser ''[[Piimi]]'' was destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces led by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] in the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']], ''Firefox'' arrived to reinforce the station but was destroyed in the battle by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
